rows.note: Use 科目 for a subject studied at school or university, especially when naming a class such as physics.

example.english: Physics is the subject I like most.
example.traditional: 我最鍾意嘅科目係物理。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 ge3 fo1 muk6 hai6 mat6 lei5

rows.note: Use 主題 as the all-purpose choice when subject means the main topic of a discussion, work, or paper.

example.english: The subject of this article is environmental protection.
example.traditional: 呢篇文章嘅主題係環保。
example.jyutping: ni1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 ge3 zyu2 tai4 hai6 waan4 bou2

rows.note: Use 主語 specifically for the grammatical subject of a clause or sentence.

example.english: In the sentence, “Siu Ming” is the subject.
example.jyutping: geoi3 zi2 jap6 min6 siu2 ming4 hai6 zyu2 jyu5

rows.note: Use 研究對象 for a person, animal, or thing being examined in research or an experiment.

example.english: The subject of this experiment is a white mouse.
example.traditional: 呢項實驗嘅研究對象係一隻白老鼠。
example.jyutping: ni1 hong6 sat6 jim6 ge3 jin4 gau3 deoi3 zoeng6 hai6 jat1 zek3 baak6 lou5 syu2
